I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell, their Director of Yard Operations.

That comes from two places Marcus can see himself. Dana's Aug 20, 2025 post in #north-team says Thea flagged the door 6 duplicates on the morning shift. The public North cheat sheet lists Thea as QFL's main contact. A contact name is an operational fact, so it's fine to share with Marcus, who is on the North team.
